first_order: calling everyone to assemble and make easy Guybrush pixel art
author: gianniballerini
text:
Guybrush pixel art in r/Place

We need Monkey Island pixel art in [r/place](https://www.reddit.com/r/place)!!!  Let's assemble and do something! 
[This should be easy to make!](http://www.stickaz.com/2241-3055-large/guybrush.png)

author: Licheno
text: It's a shame that the gaming culture of our generation is only about alienating multiplayer games rather then real art masterpieces like Monkey Island
